hooks.command: RESULT=$(bash .claude/skills/verify/verify.sh --full 2>/dev/null | tail -1); VERDICT=$(echo "$RESULT" | grep -oE 'VERDICT=[A-Z]+' | cut -d= -f2); if [ "$VERDICT" = 'REJECTED' ]; then echo "  ⛔ pre-commit harness: $RESULT — REJECTED: 커밋 전 문제를 수정하세요"; else echo "  ✅ pre-commit harness: $RESULT"; fi

bash .claude/hooks/system-check.sh --brief 2>/dev/null; LOOP=$(cat .execution-loop-state 2>/dev/null || echo '없음'); DELTA=$(tail -3 objective-loop-log.md 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'delta: [+\-][0-9]+' | tail -1 || echo '없음'); CHECKPOINT=$(tail -1 .harness-checkpoint 2>/dev/null | cut -d'|' -f3 | tr -d ' ' || echo '없음'); echo "  💡 세션 시작: progress.md → architecture.md 순으로 읽은 후 시작하세요"; echo "  📍 루프: $LOOP | 마지막 delta: $DELTA | 체크포인트: $CHECKPOINT"
